pillar_artifacts.title: GMUT fold-state typing board
pillar_artifacts.body: A symbolic board maps model terms to units, domain, approximation, provenance, sign convention, and explicit falsifier fields. Fold-state language is only an inspectable bookkeeping analogy; the board evaluates no observation, likelihood, posterior, force, or physical mechanism and supplies no empirical GMUT result.

pillar_artifacts.title: THOS deterministic package handover proxy
pillar_artifacts.body: Synthetic archive members, manifest order, executable-bit policy, clock declarations, duplicate-name refusal, and second-person handover readback exercise bounded state transitions. Every package, file, actor, institution, incident, and result is fictional.

pillar_artifacts.title: Freed ID attestation-envelope profile
pillar_artifacts.body: Synthetic DSSE and in-toto-shaped records separate payload identity, predicate shape, issuer intent, verifier policy, status, recovery, and context binding. No real key, signature, credential, issuer, holder, verifier, or trust decision is present.

pillar_artifacts.title: CBR authority and accessibility reservations
pillar_artifacts.body: The matrix reserves affected-user accessibility evaluation, privacy, remedy, legal, cultural, data-governance, tangata whenua, iwi, hapu, and Maori-authority decisions to competent external people and authorities. Repository software makes zero real decision.
